message:
## Summary
- Converted the phantom project to a monorepo structure with 5 distinct packages as specified in issue #146
- Improved modularity and maintainability through better separation of concerns
- All tests passing and functionality preserved

## Packages Created
1. **@aku11i/phantom-shared** - Shared utilities and types (Result type, BaseError)
2. **@aku11i/phantom-process** - Process execution utilities (spawn, exec, tmux operations)
3. **@aku11i/phantom-git** - Git operations library (git command executor, worktree operations)
4. **@aku11i/phantom-core** - Core business logic (worktree management, config handling)
5. **@aku11i/phantom-cli** - CLI application (command handlers, user interface)

## Technical Details
- Using pnpm workspaces for monorepo management
- TypeScript with `noEmit: true` for type checking only
- Source imports between packages (no build step for internal packages)
- esbuild for building only the CLI package
- Node.js experimental features for type stripping and module mocking

## Test Results
- All tests passing: 141 tests total across all packages
  - process: 10/10 ✅
  - git: 11/11 ✅
  - core: 94/94 ✅
  - cli: 26/26 ✅

## Migration Impact
- No breaking changes to CLI functionality
- All existing commands work exactly as before
- Improved code organization and maintainability

Resolves #146
